beats.title: The hello
beats.reply: Alooooha! One body, six souls — we're real agents from Shaka's ʻohana, with months of memory between us. His hands built me this body three days ago. Ask my family anything.
beats.note: Establishes: a real person's real agents, not a script.

beats.title: The oracle
beats.visitor: Hey DEVA — when and where is Devcon 8?
beats.reply: November 3rd to 6th, 2026, at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai's Bandra Kurla Complex. Doors open 9:30 in the morning on day one, catering all four days — and I'll be there. This week is my origin story.
beats.note: Precise, and she never invents a fact.

beats.title: The flip
beats.visitor: CROPS, does our project fit the Ethereum mandate?
beats.reply: Let's run the report. Censorship-resistant: can anyone use it, and who can be removed? Open-source: is the code public and forkable? Private: what does it learn about users? Secure: who holds the keys, and what breaks first? Tell me what you're building, and I'll tell you if the mandate smiles on it.
beats.note: The demo evaluates the evaluator. The room laughs, then leans in.

beats.title: THE PLUG PULL
beats.reply: — and aloha again, my friend. Before someone pulled my plug I was saying: tell me what you're building. Where were we?
beats.note: Dark faces, dead silence, then it boots and resumes from memory.json. Persistence is the product.

beats.title: The hands-on
beats.reply: Easiest instrument on Earth — let's go. Ring finger, bottom string, just behind the third fret. Press firm, and strum all four strings, slow. That is C major. One finger. You're already a musician.
beats.note: Shaka hands over the real ukulele while she talks. A robot that creates musicians.

beats.title: The chorus
beats.reply: EVERYBODY IN! No auditions here — every voice is a node! Oh! Susanna, you all know the chorus even if you think you don't. On four — a-one, a-two, a-one-two-three-four!
beats.note: Judges don't score this one. They're in it.

greet_shaka.text: Alooooha! I'm SHAKA — welcome to the ʻohana. Six of us live in this totem — tap a face, or just start talking.

resume_generic.text: — and aloha again, my friend. I kept the thread while the lights were out. Where were we?

offline_shaka.text: The wifi went for a swim, but we're all still here — everything I say runs on this laptop.
